description: The file contains implementation of block management for a reftable data structure, including functions for reading, initializing, and writing blocks, managing restart points, compression, and iteration over records within a block.

classes.name: struct reftable_block
classes.description: Represents a block of reftable data, including data buffer, uncompressed data, compression stream, and metadata such as type, restart points, and sizes.

classes.name: struct reftable_block_data
classes.description: Holds raw block data and associated metadata.

classes.name: struct block_iter
classes.description: Iterator for traversing records within a block, maintaining current position and last key.

classes.name: struct restart_needle_less_args
classes.description: Arguments for binary search comparison function to find restart points matching a key.

classes.name: struct reftable_iterator
classes.description: Generic iterator structure with virtual function table for traversal operations.

methods.description: Returns the size of the header based on version.

methods.name: size_t footer_size(int version)
methods.description: Returns the size of the footer based on version.
